Plan routes and save places in Kummel at home, then transfer them to the plotter on the boat. It works the other way too. Kummel uses GPX, which almost all plotters and navigation apps can read: Garmin, Raymarine, Simrad, B&G, Lowrance, Furuno, Navionics and more.

From Kummel to the plotter

Routes with more than {7} points are simplified, because many plotters cannot handle more per route. You can also export a single route from Saved routes.

From the plotter to Kummel

Routes become saved routes, waypoints become places and recorded tracks go into the logbook. Nothing you already have is removed.

How to do it on the plotter

Memory card: save the file to an SD or microSD card and insert it in the plotter. Choose import under files or user data. On Garmin the file goes in the Garmin/GPX folder on the card.
Via an app: many plotters can receive routes from the manufacturer's phone app, for example Garmin ActiveCaptain or C-MAP. Share the file there from Kummel.
From the plotter: export routes, waypoints or tracks to the memory card as GPX and import the file here.

Kummel is the nautical chart for Åland, the Turku archipelago and the Uusimaa coast: depths, navigation marks, shoals, marine weather, routes with arrival times, and fishing. Made by boaters for their own waters: from the Sea of Åland in the west, through all of Åland and the Turku archipelago with Turku and Naantali, along the Uusimaa coast past Hanko and Helsinki to Pellinge off Porvoo in the east.

{1}

This is where Kummel always lives. Feel free to tell your boating and fishing friends.
Kummel on the web

Official sources

Depths and chart: Traficom. Fairways, navigation marks, lighthouses and waterway signs: Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency. Rocks, shoals and aerial photos: National Land Survey of Finland. Water level and water temperature: Finnish Meteorological Institute. Vessels (AIS): Digitraffic. Weather forecast: Open-Meteo. Base map: OpenStreetMap. The chart is updated every week.

Contact

Questions, ideas or errors in the map? Email {3}. Tell us where the error is and we'll fix it or report it to the right authority.

Your fishing spots are yours

Places, routes, catches and photos are stored only on this device. Kummel has no database and no accounts, so nobody else can see them, not even us who make the app. The only things that leave the phone are what you share yourself, and when you share a catch you choose whether the location is shown. To fetch weather, water levels and maps, the map position is sent to each service, but never to us. {4}{5}
{6}

Tips

Hold your finger on the map to save a place. Rotate the map with two fingers. Tap the position button twice for course up. Set your boat's draught under Menu → Boats, and shallow water is highlighted for your boat. Add Kummel to your home screen and it opens like an app.
Kummel is not a certified navigation aid. Route suggestions and warnings are aids: the skipper is always responsible for navigation. Chart data from Traficom (CC BY 4.0) is not intended for navigation.
